_doc: Trending clipper video effects applied cleanly before captions and overlays by app/pipeline/effects.py.

none.name: Clean Original
none.description: Original camera colors with no filter or motion FX overlay.

hdr_punch.name: Viral HDR Crisp
hdr_punch.description: Punchy micro-contrast, rich skin/color pop, sharpening & subtle edge vignette used by top podcast clippers.

hook_flash.name: Hook White Flash
hook_flash.description: 2-frame bright flash at 0.0s to reset viewer attention immediately, paired with a crisp contrast boost.

chromatic_glitch.name: RGB Chromatic Burst
chromatic_glitch.description: RGB lens channel split burst on the opening hook and at 5s for instant tech/viral energy.

blur_reveal.name: Blur-to-Sharp Reveal
blur_reveal.description: Opens with a smooth 0.38s lens blur that snaps razor-sharp right as the speaker hooks the viewer.

motion_shake.name: Impact Hook Shake
motion_shake.description: Controlled punch camera shake + flash in the opening 0.55s to lock eyes on high-energy reactions.

dark_cinema.name: Dark Podcast Studio
dark_cinema.description: Moody studio contrast with cool teal shadows, warm midtones, and a deep vignette.

dreamy_bloom.name: Warm Halation Bloom
dreamy_bloom.description: Soft glowing highlights with warm golden halation for motivational, lifestyle & emotional stories.

warm_film.name: 35mm Cinema Grain
warm_film.description: Kodak-inspired warm film tone with subtle organic 35mm texture and soft shadow falloff.

vhs_retro.name: Retro Cam / Y2K
vhs_retro.description: Analog chroma bleed, nostalgic tape grain & vintage fade used in storytelling & trivia edits.

noir_sigma.name: B&W Contrast Noir
noir_sigma.description: Stark high-contrast monochrome with deep vignette — iconic for bold hot takes & dramatic quotes.
